cohort: 230 pregnant women with high-risk pregnancies admitted to the labor room at gestational age > 33 weeks at KIMS BBSR, Odisha, India between 2018-2020.
finding: Pathological admission CTG was associated with a significantly higher incidence of fetal distress, meconium-stained liquor, NICU admission, and APGAR score < 7 compared to suspicious and normal CTG.
